Message: a dynamic: runtime query returns rows other than those it reads, through GROUP BY, HAVING, DISTINCT, an aggregate, window or set-returning function, or a compound; .Count(ctx) wraps the original in a subquery so the count reflects outer-result rows rather than the underlying table
